tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul chen mo mahā mā ya'i rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ dpal ldan rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang*/ dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde ba dam pa thugs rje'i stobs/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam snying po'i ye shes ni/ /mtha' yas sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ston mkhas pa/ / gcig pu mchog tu che ba lhag pa'i lhar/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang shing*/ / mgrin pa dma' bas zhabs btud de/ /mtha' med 'khor ba ji sṛd bar/ / dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud rgyal yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i re bskong gang*/ /gzhan ngor mdzes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /tshig gi me tog 'phreng bas mchod/ /de la 'dir dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rgyud rgyas pa las yongs su phyung ba nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di ni tshig tshogs shin du nyung yang don lhag par rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje'i tshig gi don rnam par dbye dka' ba'i phyir/ byis pa'i blo can bdag lta bu rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin yang*/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag legs par mnos shing*/ rdo rje theg pa la tshad mar gyur pa'i grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi gsung gi rgyun thos pa dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam par bshad pa la brten nas/ rang gi blo dang 'tsham par ci nus shig dbye bar bya'o/ /de la sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs la legs par shes nas rgyud kyi tshig don la 'jug dgos pa las/ dang po ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ gnyis pa la yang*/ theg pa bla na med pa'i rgyud spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa/ rgyud gsum gyi don la nges pa rnyed cing*/ khyad par du/ rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ nges tshig dang*/

go rim dang*/ grol bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ bye brag tu bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ yan lag drug dang*/ de dag gi sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras rnams dmigs phyed pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub kyi sems rnams dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo la/ rlung sems dbu mar 'jug byed dang*/ zhugs zin gyi bya ba rnams dang*/ rim pa gnyis la drod thob nas spyod pas 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba'i tshul dang*/ lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rnam par bzhag pa rnams la nges pa rnyed pa zhig dgos pas de dag kyang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa rgyud 'di nyid kyi mngon par rtogs pa la/ sde snod gang du gtogs pa ngos bzung ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan gyi dgos don dang*/ mi yul du sus spyan drangs pa dang*/ rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don bstan pa dang*/ rgyud gsum gyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag pa ste don tshan lnga las/ dang po ni/ mdo dang sngags gnyis las sngags kyi theg pa dang*/ de la rgyud sde bzhi las rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ de la yang pha rgyud dang*/ ma rgyud gnyis las ma rgyud ces bya ba/ shes rab kyi rgyud dam rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces kyang bya bar gtogs te/ de skad du/ rig pa 'jig rten gsum po na/ khyod dang mnyam pa nga las med/ ces mahā ma ya'i rgyud 'di'i rig sngags ni/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i rig sngags yin par bshad cing*/ sngags de nyid lha mo'i rigs sngags yin la/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ las tshogs kyi cho ga thams cad sngags de nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la dbye na rigs drug tu yod pa las/ rigs kyi gtso bo he ru ka'i rigs su gtogs shing*/

yang ma rgyud kyi gtso bo'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rdo rje gur las/ ji skad du/ mkha' 'gro sde dang rgya mtsho sde dang nam mkha' dang*/ /gser gyi char pa dang ni dga' chen za nus dang*/ /bde chen sgeg pa dang ni gsang ba yid bde dang*/ /rgyud de rnams la phan pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gsang ba mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba'i/ /'khor lo bde mchog gur dang phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ni drug par grags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te ma rgyud bcu bzhi las 'di ni gsang ba yid bde'o/ /'di la rgya bod gnyis na bshad rgyud rang rkang pa ni med la/ gsang ba kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi le'u 'ga' zhig gis rgyud 'di bshad par grags na'ang de ni da lta bod na med cing*/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du/ rgyud 'di'i tshig rags rim rnams 'dren par mdzad cing ci rigs pa mi gsal ba gsal ba'i phyir bshad pa yang mdzad la/ zla gsang thig le dang cung zad 'brel ba dang*/ 'di'i rgyud don ci rigs pa saṃ pu ṭis kyang cung zad 'chad cing phag mo don grub ma'i rtog pa dang*/ 'phreng ba'i rig pa 'dzin ma'i rtog pa gnyis kyang rgyud 'di'i phyogs mthun du snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di le'u gsum tshigs su bcad pa dgu bcu lhag bcas tsam dang lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor kho na dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa yang gzhan las mdor bsdus par gsungs pa ni/ gang zag bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i ched yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon ku ku rī pas spyan drangs pa ste/ de nyid kyi lo rgyus su lta'o/ /bod kyi yul du thog mar 'gos khug pas bsgyur bshad mdzad cing*/ lo tsa ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis kyang gtan la phab mod kyi/ 'di ni rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa nas brgyud pa ste/

des kyang slob dpon shan+ti pa'i lugs dang*/ nag po pa'i lugs dang*/ nā ro pa'i man ngag gi lugs gsum rdzogs par gsan zhing*/ slob dpon gzhan gyi man ngag kyang ci rigs pa gsan par gsal la/ phyis slob dpon ku ku rī pa nyid la ye shes kyi snang ba'i tshul gyis dngos su gnang ba nod pa yin no/ /rnam thar yongs khyab lhad can rnams su/ ku ku rī pa dang zhi ba bzang po gcig par 'dod pa ni mun sprul te/ zhi ba bzang po ni mar 'gos gnyis char kyi bla ma/ rje mar pas kyang rgyud sde gzhan mang po gsan pa'i bla ma'ang yin mod kyi/ de nyid mahā ma ya'i rgyud la ches mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yin pas/ mahā ma ya bla ma thar pa'i lam ston kyi rjes su 'brangs zhes/ gtso bor nag po shan+ti bha dra dang bzhed pa mthun la/ dpal nā ro pa'i man ngag gi khyad par cung zad tsam gyis brgyan pa'o/ /'dir dbang rgyud man ngag gsum char mar lugs kyis gzhung bsrangs nas/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag legs chas cung zad brgyan par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud kyi chings sam bsdus pa'i don te rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ ngas gsang sngags kyi po ti gang bshad kyang*/ po ti de'i dkyus stod smad kyi don thams cad thun chung gcig gi nang du bsdus nas/ slob ma'i blo la skyel shes pa yin gsung ste/ 'dir don gyi gtso bo sum cu rtsa gnyis su bsdu'o/ /de yang*/ sa chog / sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dbang bskur ba ste bzhi'am/ yang na bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ bzhi pa tshig dbang ste dbang gi mngon rtogs bzhi po ngo bo thabs rgyud yin yang*/ rgyu rgyud bsos 'debs byed yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu rgyud kyi mngon rtogs su mdzad la/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rigs gnyis 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor/

mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig ste brgyad ni thabs rgyud kyi mngon rtogs dang*/ las chen brgyad thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad/ mchog gi dngos grub la sku bzhi ste/ nyi shu ni 'bras rgyud kyi mngon rtogs so/ /de rnams su rgyud don mtha' dag 'dus pa ma yin kyang sgrub pa po la nye bar mkho ba'i don gyi gtso bo thams cad tshang ba yin no/ /yang na/ sgom bya dngos po'i gnas lugs/ sgom pa po gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ de ltar sgoms pa'i 'bras bu ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lus sems kyi gnas lugs sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa dang*/ dam tshig ma nyams pa dgos pas de'i rnam gzhag go /gsum pa ni sngags dbyibs chos gsum spyod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni las dang dngos grub ste/ bzhi po 'dis ni/ rgyud don ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par bsdus so/ /lnga pa la/ rgyu rgyud kyi rang bzhin bstan pa/ thabs rgyud kyi rim pa bshad pa/ 'bras rgyud kyi rnam par bzhag pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid yin pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyi dbyings dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi rten dang*/ rang gi rig pa'i bdag nyid du gnas pa ste khyad par lnga las/ dang po ni/ gang zhig gis ni kun khyab pa/ /zhes dang*/ sems dang sems med sems rang bzhin/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag cing rnyog pa med/ /ces dang*/gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum po yang spro'o/ /zhes dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ tshangs la sogs pa bdag nyid che/ zhes dang*/ lnga pa ni/ sgrub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan no/ /de yang rags par na rgyu rgyud ni rten gyis gang zag ste/ dbang bzhi thob pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'o/

/de yang zhib mor na de'i sems rgyud do/ /de'i phyir rgyu rgyud dngos ni sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba yin la/ rgyu rgyud kyis bsdus pa ni/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ smin byed dbang bzhi/ grol byed rim pa gnyis/ bsrung bya dam tshig /nye rgyu spyod pa/ bgrod bya lam gyi rnam gzhag ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo rab sbyor bas/ /zhes sogs kyis dkyil 'khor sgrub pa bstan/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'phrog pa dang*/ zhes pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad ces pas bum dbang bstan/ 'phrog pa dang*/ lha mchog las skyes bu mo spyad/ ces pas gsang dbang bstan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug byed rig pa/ /zhes pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bstan/ de bzhin du ni zhes pas dbang bzhi pa bstan te/ tshigs su bcad pa de nyid la sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i bshad pa'i don no/ / man ngag gzhan las ni/ mig 'phrul byed ces pa'i tshig kyang dbang bzhi pa ston byed du mdzad de shin tu legs so/ /gnyis pa la/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po ni/ dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor te/ 'di la yang rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ sprul pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skad cig gam sa bon las bskyed pa tsam gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pas sgom zhing*/ bsgom bya'i lha yang sprul gzhi rdo rje sems dpa' nyid bsgom pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yin la/ phyi ma ni cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yin kyang rung ste/ bsgom bya lha ni he ru ka'am mkha' 'gro ma bsgom pa'o/ /'dir man ngag gzhan gyi dgongs pa ltar rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i cha yod de/ rdzogs rim gyi lha sku thams cad rang bzhin dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor yin la/ bskyed rim du gtogs pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin te/ de ltar na/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor la yang*/

dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bskyed rim kho nar nges pa dang*/ mchog dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs rim kho nar nges pa'o/ /de'i phyir bskyed rdzogs thams cad sngags dbyibs chos gsum du/ 'du yang dman pa dbyibs/ zab pa sngags/ mthar thug chos zhes bya ba gsum du mi 'du zhing*/ de ltar 'chad pa ni nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo gsum bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sngon bskyed rim la goms pa zhig gis rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe lha sku ched du ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs kyis 'char ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma snang bas so zhes pa 'di rang lugs su bzung bar bya'o/ /'dir he ru ka lha lnga'i bskyed pa'i rim pa'i don cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la chos bcu bzhi las/ dang po bla ma dag pa'i cho ga ni/ sbyang bya skye ba snga mar 'phen 'grub kyi las gsogs pa spyod zhing*/ sbyangs 'bras bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa mtshon/ gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yang yul mchog dman gyi khyad ma gtogs de dang don mthun zhing lha rnams snying rje chen por 'char bar byed/ gsum pa stong nyid bsgoms pas/ 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku lam du byed/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i dus na rlung sems snying khar 'dus pa'i 'od gsal 'char bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu grung po byed cing*/ snang ba stong nyid du 'char ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa bsrung 'khor ni/ gtso bor bar chad bsrung ba'i ched yin la/ skye ba len pa la gegs med pa dang*/ bdud bzhi bcom pa mtshon/ lnga pa rten dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la/ lha'i gnas bskyed pa dang*/ lha dngos bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni chos 'byung gi nam mkha' mtshon zhing dkyil 'khor bde stong du shes par byed/ 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa grub pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/

ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtshon/ rdzogs rim gyi rten/ spyi bo rlung*/ mgrin pa me/ snying kha chu/ lte ba sa/ dbu ma ri rab/ pad+ma rtsa 'khor/ rdo rje ni 'byung ba'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams mtshon la de'i tshe lha bskyed pa ni rdzogs rim gyi ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma'i mngal gyi gnas dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhing rnam par dag pa dbus kyi pad+ma yin la/ hriḥyig ni bar do'i rnam shes/ de nas byung ba'i thig le'i gong bu ni mngal du gnas pa'i khu khrag dang sprul sku dang sku rdo rje/ yig 'bru ni bar do'i rlung sems der zhugs pa dang longs sku dang gsung rdo rje/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa ni yan lag dang dbang po rnams dod pa dang chos sku dang thugs rdo rje/ 'od zer spro bsdu ni lus 'phel ba/ zhal phyag rdzogs pa ni mngal nas btsas pa dang bde ba chen po'i sku mtshon no/ /drug pa glus bskul ba ni/ dbus kyi thig le'i gong bu khu khrag sems gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i nus pas 'phel ba dang tshad med bzhis gzhan don la bskul ba yin no/ /bdun pa gtso bo bskyed pa la/ sa bon ni rtsa dang srog gi rlung chags pa ste phyag mtshan man chad gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i bskyed chog ni/ sku bzhi lam du byed pa rim pa bzhi bskyed ces bya ba rim pa logs pa zhig yin la/ sgrub thabs gzhan dang gzhan las ni mngon byang lnga bskyed dang*/ cho ga gsum bskyed dang*/ 'od kyi gong bu las bskyed pa dang*/ rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbye ba byed pa sogs mang du yod mod/ rdo rje'i tshig gcig la don du ma 'thad ldan du 'byung ba'i phyir thams cad kyang legs pa kho na ste/ 'on kyang rgyud 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa ni dkyus nyid yin par gsal lo/ /brgyad pa yi ge dgod pa ni mig sogs skye mched rdzogs shing lus ngag yid gsum dang rlung sems kyi stobs 'phel ba dang/

yon tan mtha' dag gis brgyan zhing rdo rje gsum gcig tu gyur pa dang sku gsum mnyam pa nyid mtshon/ dgu pa ye shes pa bsre ba ni/ lo bcu drug gi mthar tshor ba dang 'du shes rdzogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa mtshon/ bcu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs dang mthun pa'i las la dbang bsgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba mtshon/ bcu gcig pa mchod pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pas bstod pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi myangs ba gsum ni rim pas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gsum mnyes shing bskul ba'i ched du yin la/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba mtshon no/ /bcu bzhi pa/ dag pa dran pa ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa de yang gzung 'dzin can gyi snang ba las 'das te yang dag pa'i ye shes su shes pa'i ched yin la/ de dag gi mthar lhar snang la sems brtan por sgrub dgos pa yin no/ /de yang tha mal du snang ba bzlog pa'i don du lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa dang*/ tha mal gyi zhen pa ldog pa'i don du lha'i nga rgyal la bslab pa gnyis nges par dgos shing re zhig bskyed rim kho na bsgom pa'i tshe lhar snang dang*/ nga rgyal de yang yang dag pa'i ye shes su bsgyur ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba las bslab dgos shing*/ bskyed rdzogs lhan gcig tu sgom pas ni de'i bya ba rdzogs rim gyis 'grub pa'i phyir chos kyi rnal 'byor las gzhan pa'i stong pa'i rgyas gdab mi dgos so/ /mthar dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ 'du byed kyi tha ma 'jig par 'gyur ba nges par sbyong shing*/ sprul pa sna tshogs pa thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pas mtshon la rdzogs rim kyi skabs su 'od gsal 'char sla zhing gnas skabs 'di nyid du yang mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang*/

byin rlabs brtan pa'i dgos pa rnams yod do/ /de ltar bskyed rim de nyid lam gyi gtso bo yin la ngag gi zhen pa bzlog cing lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa byed pa dang*/ las sgrub cing bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ zas kyi bya ba bsod nams kyi tshogs su bsgyur ba'i phyir kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gnyid dge bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te/ de rnams rnal 'byor gyi yan lag yin no/ /de lta bu'i bskyed rim gzhung dang sbyar ba ni/ yid kyi pad+ma bsam bya ba/ /sogs kyis rten gyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi/ sogs la spyi don gyi bshad pa sbyar bas/ thig le'i gong bu bstan/ yi ge dang ni sngags gzugs kyi/ zhes pa'i yi ge zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis sa bon dang*/ sngags zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis phyag mtshan dang*/ gzugs zhes pas sku yongs su rdzogs pa bstan te/ de yang shar du ut+pal sngon po'i mdog /ces sogs kyis rgyas par bshad do/ /byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ yi ge zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig dang*/ khyad par skye mched byin rlabs ni/ yi ge drug dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs ni/ dang po'i sngags dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dbang bskur ni/ sangs rgyas gzugs kyi nyer brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ le'u gsum par/ brgyud pa'i tha mar legs gnas pa/ /zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bskul/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bstan te/ 'di'i bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa zhig go /bzlas pa ni/ sngags zhes pa dang*/ gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs dang*/ bzang po'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams/ /zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig gis bstan/

gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba yi/ sogs kyis shugs la 'phangs pa yin no/ /lhag ma rnams ni bskyed rim spyi'i 'gros sbyar bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ chos kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ sgyu ma gsum rgyud dang 'brel ba rnams so/ /dang po la steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la yang 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la man ngag gi dbye bas/ 'khor lo gcig la brten pa dang*/ 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa ste gsum yod kyang rdo rje'i tshig gcig gis bstan te/ ā li kā li mnyam byas te/ sogs kyis so/ /'di ni rgyud sde gzhan las gsungs pa'i gtum mo me dmigs kyi rnal 'byor ro/ gnyis pa la/ steng gi sna rtse dang 'brel ba snying khar bsgom pa dang*/ lus kyi dbus su bsgom pa dang*/ 'og gi sna rtser bsgom pa dang gsum yod la/ dang po la/ slob dpon so so'i man ngag gi dbye bas gdams ngag tha dad pa yod kyang ngo bo ni snying kha'i thig ler gcig cing*/ de yang*/ bzang po'i yi ge'i 'phreng ba rnams zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi sogs la sbas don gyi bshad pa'i phyogs gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rtag tu shes rab thabs sogs kyi/ /zhes pa'i nang bshad dang*/ brgyad pa'i mtha' mar legs gnas pa sogs/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs ston pa'i tshig rnams nyid kyis bstan no/ /gsum pa phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang 'brel ba rnams dang*/ bum pa can dang 'brel pa rnams so/ /dang po la man ngag mang du yod kyang ston byed kyi tshig ni/ gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ sogs te sgra ji bzhin pas bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi btsan thabs su dgag pa ni/

mig gnyis dang ni rna ba dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan cing*/ sbyor bas dgag pa ni/ srogs dang rtsol ba bsdams nas su/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ nges pa med sogs dang*/ rtag tu shes rab/ sogs dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i tshig dang*/ spyod pa ston pa rnams kyis kyang 'chad do/ /gnyis pa chos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gang gang dbang po'i lam las ni/ /sogs kyis gsal bar bstan zhing*/ shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs 'chad pa rnams kyis kyang don gyis bstan pa yin

no/ /gsum pa sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams pa dang 'brel ba bstan pa ni/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal gnyis su 'du zhing*/ dang po la yang mnyam rjes gnyis su dbye/ de nas 'od gsal chos sku'i lam dang*/ mnyam bzhag sgyu ma longs sku'i lam dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma sprul sku'i lam ste/ ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal gtso bor gyur pa'i 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag bstan la/ rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu lus kyi khyad chos rlung sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ gong bur song ba'i 'od de yi/ /zhes pa'i sbas bshad pa dang*/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /zhes pa'i don phyogs gcig dang*/ dpag tshad brgya'i khyon tsam du/ /'di ni rab tu snang bar byed/ /ces pa rnams kyis bstan zhing*/ de nyid 'jig rten pa'i lha'i mig gis mthong ba ni/ thams cad kyis ni mi mthong zhing*/ zhes pas bstan/ de dag gtso bor mnyam bzhag sgyu ma yin zhing*/ rjes thob sgyu ma ni/ stong phrag gcig tu snang bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'i tshig gis 'phangs pa yin no/ /sgyu ma de spyod pa la bltos pa ni/ gang gi shes pa'i dngos grub kyis sogs dang*/ phyag rgya la bltos pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi grub sbyor bas/ sogs so/de ltar rgyud kyis ji skad bstan pa'i tshul mdo tsam du shes nas/ de dag gi snying po cung zad tsam brjod na/ sgrub po mtha' dag gis/ mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor thog mtha' bar gsum gyis gnas skabs thams cad dang*/ 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dus skabs ci rigs par sgrub dgos pa kho na yin la/ steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor rnam grangs mang po de dag las gang yang rung ba gcig ni nges par bsgom dgos kyang*/ thams cad gang zag gcig gis nges par bsgom dgos par ni ma nges te/ shin tu brtson pas ring du goms pa las ni re res kyang drod chung ngu'i rtogs pa bskyes par nus te/

de nas 'og sgo'i rnal 'byor la brten te/ drod chen po dang*/ rtse mo'i bar du bgrod par nus pa yin no/ /des na rnal 'byor 'di rnams la lam khrigs chags kyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ lam blo chod kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ dang po ltar na thams cad gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen du sdebs pa yin te/ de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa la cung zad brtan pa'i gang zag gis dang por rlung sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la cung zad bslab/ de nas thog mar thur sel gyi rlung dbang du byed pa'i phyir/ 'og gi sna rtse la gnad du bsnun pa'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ des gsang ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba'am lhod por song ba na/ de'i rkyen gyis snying kha'i rtsa mdud kyang 'byed par sla ba'i phyir snying khar sgom pa la bslab bo/ /de nyid steng gi sna rtse dang yang 'brel bas/ srog rlung gi bya ba byed pa'i gnas snying kha gtso bor gyur pa'i lus de yan chad kyi rtsa 'khor thams cad kyi rtsa mdud 'jig cing dag par byed do/ /de dag gis rtsa mdud grol ba'am lhod por song ba na/ rang lus la brten pa'i dga' bzhi rdzogs par bskyed pa'i phyir 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ yur ba legs par bcos nas chu 'dren pa ltar rtsa'i lam rnams byang pa na/ gtum mo la brten nas dga' bzhi 'dren pa yin no/ /des kyang khams phra mo rnams thim dka' bar gyur pa na/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor lus kyi dbus su bsgoms pas khams phra rags kyi thim tshul ci rigs pa 'phral du 'byung zhing*/ de yan chad du 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom yang rung*/ mi bsgom yang rung ste/ skabs 'di nyid nas 'og sgo nges par bogs 'byin dgos la/ de la brten nas lam gyi lhan skyes sems rnam par dben pa mthar phyin pa thob cing*/ de'i skad cig gnyis par rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ro/

/de ltar yang*/ dus bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /'grub par 'gyur pa goms pa'i mchog ces dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma'i grub sbyor bas/ / 'phral du yid ches yang dag 'jug ces so/ /gnyis pa lam blo chod ltar na/ bskyed rim la cung zad brtan pa thob pa'am bskyed rdzogs lhan cig tu bsgom yang rung ste/ rdzogs rim 'khor lo sngags kyi rnal 'byor kho na bsgoms pas thog mar lte bar rlung sems zhugs gnas thim gsum byed cing*/ de las gtum mo rim gyis 'bar/ ro ma las brgyud de spyi bor phyin pa na/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig bzhu ba'i rgyun rkyang ma nas 'bab par 'gyur la/ de nyid lte bar 'phrad pa'i bde drod khyad par can skyes pa na/ rim pas dbu ma'i nang du 'bar 'dzag 'byung*/ des thog mar lte ba'i rtsa mdud rnams grol zhing*/ de nas spyi bo'i rtsa mdud grol bar 'gyur/ spyi bo grol bas mgrin pa yang bde blag tu grol zhing*/ lte ba dang mgrin pa grol bas mthar snying kha yang dka' ba med par grol bar 'gyur te 'bar 'dzag gi dga' bzhi yang yang drangs pas lam gyi dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga'am/ snang mched kyi rtogs pa skyed thub cing*/ de nas 'og sgos bogs phyung bas lam gyi lhan skyes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ thig le sngags kyi rnal 'byor lus kyi dbus su bsgoms pas kyang sna sgo nas brtsams te/ dpral pa'i rtsa mdud lhod po byed cing*/ de'i rjes su gsang ba'i rtsa mdud dang*/ de nas 'khor lo gsum cha mnyam du lhod por 'gyur la/ mthar ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gag pa nas dbu mar rlung thim dmar cha 'bar te/ ro ma'i lam nas 'gro ba sogs gong bzhin rtogs pa skye'o/ /yang 'og gi sna rtse dang dbu ma'i mas snar gnad du bsnan pa las/ thog mar dmigs pa'i bye brag gi nor bu'am bde skyong 'khor lo thur sel gyis dbang byas pa'i rlung rnams bzlog cing thim par 'gyur nges rang gnas kyi rtsa mdud 'grol zhing*/

gtsug tor dang spyi bo'i rtsa mdud kyang lhod por 'gyur la/ khyad par de dag tu rlung thim pa'i rkyen gyis dbu ma'i mas sna yongs su gang zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ las kyi rlung gsar du grub nas/ des lte 'og sor bzhir gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i me drag tu sbar bar nus/ me rlung de nyid kyi shugs kyis lte ba'i a shad kyang cung zad 'bar bar byed mod kyi/ sngar lte bar rlung sems thim par byed pa'i rdzogs rim gzhan ma bsgoms na lte ba'i gtum mo stobs chung bas las thams cad tshangs pa'i mes byed de/ ro ma nas 'bar bas spyi bo dang gtsug tor gyi thig le ci rigs par bzhu nas rkyang ma nas babs te/ lte bar 'phrod pa lan mang du byung ba na/ lte ba'i gtum mo yang stobs rgyas te dbu mar 'bar 'dzag byed pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du snying khar sgom pa la yang rlung bcu po thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnas snying kha yin zhing*/ lus chags pa na yang thog mar snying kha nas chags/ 'chi ba'i tshe yang mthar rlung sems snying khar 'dus pas gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i lus kyi gnas gtso bo yin no/ /'on kyang thabs gzhan gyi 'phrul med na rtsa mdud shin tu dbye bar dka' ba yin mod kyis/ man ngag gi gnad khyad par can gyis zin pa la ni tshegs chen po mi dgos pa yin no/ /de yang dang por snying khar srog gis dbang byas pa'i rlung rnams ci rigs par log pas rtsa mdud 'grol sla bar gyur pa na rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas pas smig ma'i sbubs 'gags pa thur mas bsangs pa bzhin du rtsa'i lam yangs por gyur zhing rtsa mdud rnams kyang lhod por 'gyur ro/ /snying kha'i rtsa mdud lhod por gyur pas lte ba dang mgrin pa yang rim gyis lhod por 'gyur la/ mgrin pa'i nus pas spyi bo yang ste/ 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyi rtsa mdud lhod por gyur pa na dmigs pa gtod pa snying kha kho nar byas kyang 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyi rlung yang rang gnas su 'du ste/

thim pa la sogs pa'i rim pas gtum mo 'bar te/ des kyang snying kha'i rtsa mdud ci rigs pa 'jig la khyad par gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi 'bar 'dzag thun mong ma yin pa grub pa'i tshe/ rlan dang drod dang*/ nam zla'i dus kyi khyad par gsum 'dzoms na me tog kha bye zhing 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba bzhin snying kha'i rtsa mdud grol zhing rtsa rnams rgyas pas rlung dang khams kyi bgrod pa gnas der rim gyis thim par 'gyur ba yin la/ de thim pa las/ lam gyi dga' ba dang mchog dga' skye ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /spyir rang lus la brten pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gtso bo gtum mo'i me dmigs yin yang*/ 'dir ni 'di nyid gtso bo yin te/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas kyis kyang 'di kho na bshad do/ /'di la nyi zla kha sbyor du byed pa ni/ snying kha'i thig le de nyid khams dkar dmar kha sbyor du gnas pa mtshon zhing*/ de'i nang du thig le phra mo sgom pa ni/ dkar dmar de'i dbus na rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can tshe srog gi ngo bo sems kyi rten phra shos gang yin pa de yin te/ 'di la 'od kyi skud pa yi ge'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dkris pa ni/ dbus kyi rlung gi thig le de las ro rkyang du rgyu ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rlung rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi rlung phra mo sgra dang rtog pa bskyed par byed pas steng gi thig le'i dbus phug nas byung ste/ rlung de nyid rgyu ba'i rtsa shin tu phra ba gsum dkris rgya gram ris kyis thig le kha sbyor bcings pa'i nang du 'khor zhing rgyu ba de mtshon no/ /yang thig le dkar po ni bde ba/ dmar po ni gsal ba/ dbus kyi thig le ni stong pa/ ri mo phyed bcas bdun las bdun ni nyon yid sogs rnam shes tshogs bdun/ phyed pa ni kun gzhi rnam shes so/ /zhes phal cher 'chad la/ rje btsun mar pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa las ni/ ri mo phyed bcas bdun du bshad pa man ngag gab pa ste/

don du phyed dang bdun no/ /phyed ni nyon yid mtshon la/ drug ni rnam shes tshogs drug nyi zla kha sbyor kun gzhi/ bzang po'i thig le ni chos nyid de/ de skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar dkar po/ spros pa spangs pa'i brdar zlum po/ rtogs dka' ba'i brdar cha phra ba ste/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun ni phyed dang bdun gyi rtsa la brten/ kun gzhi ni thig le kha sbyor la rten no/ /zhes gsung ste shin tu legs par mngon no/ /phra mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la yang rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang 'brel ba rnams kyis rlung las su rung zhing rtsa mdud yang por byas nas bum pa can gyi sbyor bas thog mar dbang po'i sgo rnams kyi rlung nang du bzlog cing*/ rim gyis lte bar thim par 'gyur la/ des gtum mo 'bar ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed do/ /de ltar na 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni thams cad 'brel bar 'byung mod kyi/ de gcig pus lam rdzogs pa ltar bshad pa rnams ni/ de nyid kyang rlung sbyang ba sogs sngon 'gro gzhan la bltos pa yin pa'i phyir/ steng sgo'i rdzogs rim la gtan nas ma brten pa mi srid pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa rdzogs par bskyed pa la steng sgo dang 'og sgo'i rnal 'byor gnyis ka dgos kyi/ ya gyal ba re res chog pa ni ma yin no/ /de la phyag rgya srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gnad thams cad ni spyi dang 'dra par shes par bya'o/ /de dag bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams pa bsgoms kyang rung ma bsgoms kyang rung ste/ lam gyi dga' ba'i rtog pa nam skyes pa'i tshe/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal rang shugs kyi bsgom par nus shing*/ de nyid je bzang du 'gyur la rmi lam dang thun mtshams thams cad du lha sku'i snang ba ci rigs pa 'byung zhing*/ lha sku shar rung ma shar rung*/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sgyu lus 'khor yug tu 'byung ngo*/

/rlung sems tsam gyi sku grub pa phan chad nas rmi lam yang mnyam bzhag sgyu ma kho nar 'byung la/ rjes thob thams cad du lha sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral ba yin no/ /de la da lta las dang po pa rnams kyis sgyu ma gsum rgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgoms na/ lam gyi dga' ba'i rtogs pa ma skyes gong du yang de rnams rjes mthun pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par dngos gzhi de dag skye ba la shin tu myur ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i seng lam du grags so/ /de la sgyu ma gsum ni/ sad dus sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam sgyu ma dang*/ bar do sgyu ma'o/ /de dang 'brel ba la bsre ba gsum gsum dgu ste/ 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre/ de bzhin du/ mnyam bzhag sgyu ma longs sku/ rjes thob sgyu ma sprul sku/ gnyid 'thug chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ gnyid sad sprul sku/ 'chi ba chos sku/ bar do longs sku/ skye ba sprul sku dang bsre ba'o/ /yang 'od gsal chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ sgyu lus sprul sku dang bsre ba ste gsum du yang mdzad la/ bsre ba'i don ni lam du byed pa'o/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa dam tshig la bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig gnyis las/ dang po rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bza' ba yin la/ mchog gi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni bdud rtsi ril bu brten pa ste/ de dag kyang dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /ri lu chen po sgrub par bya/ /zhes dang*/ mthe bong dang ni sogs dang*/ dam tshig sgrub pa'i dam pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni rgyud 'dir gsungs kyi gzhan du sbas/ zhes pa'i bar rnams kyis rgyas par bshad cing*/ yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba sogs kyi byin rlabs kyang bstan la/ spyod pa ston pa'i tshig rnams kyi zhor byung la yang ci rigs par yod do/ /mchod pa'i dam tshig gi bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/

rnal 'byor dpa' chen rtag rol te/ /zhes dang*/ nyin re bzla ba btung ba'o/ / zhes pas bstan zhing*/ gzhan yang ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud 'dir rgyas par ma gsungs kyang*/ de ltar rtag tu gus ldan pas/ /zhes pas zur gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /de yang rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi po rnams phal cher thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu ma gus pa las byung ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen po bstan pa'i phyir dam tshig bsrung tshul khyad par can yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'ga' zhig rgyud 'di'i lugs la spyod pa'i rnam gzhag mi dgos par 'dod pa'ang byung mod kyi/ spros bcas kho na la bsams na ni rung yang srid kyi/ spyir spyod pa ma spyad par 'bras bu mchog la sbyor nus pa ni mi srid do/ /yang kha cig rgyud 'di las spyod pa ma bstan par 'dod pa yang rgyud don mi shes pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /des na spyir 'og sgo'i rdzogs rim ston byed thams cad kyang spyod pa'i phyogs su dgos shing*/ khyad par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs su ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid ston par byed/ /ces pas spros bcas kyi spyod pa bstan/ 'dod pa kun la nyer spyod pa/ /sogs tshigs rkang gsum gyis spros med kyi spyod pa bstan/ rnal 'byor gnyid dang yang dag ldan zhes pas shin tu spros med kyang shugs la 'phangs/ sgyu 'phrul chen po rab sbyor ba/ /sogs dang*/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sogs kyis spros bcas spros med kyi cha lugs bsgyur ba dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa bstan/ rtag tu sems can don byed pa'o/ /nas rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig sbyar gyi bar gyis spyod pa'i bya ba rnams bstan/ man ngag gzhan las ni/ phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs spyod pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag dus dang bcas pa'ang bstan par bzhed pas/ spyod pa ston byed kyi gzhung tshig nyung yang don shin tu rgyas so/

/lnga pa ni/ dkyus kyi rgyud bshad dang*/ man ngag na gsal bar mi bzhugs pas/ dpal he ru ka'i gnas brnyes pa rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi skyabs gcig pu 'phags yul lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag mdo tsam brjod na/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skyes kyang rung*/ ma skyes kyang rung*/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob na tshogs lam bgra

ོ da pa yin zhing*/ bskyed rim ma bsgoms par rdzogs rim gyis tshogs lam dang*/ drod 'bring tsam bgrod pa'ang yod mod/ drod chen po thob pa la ni rim pa gnyis ka sgom dgos pa kho na yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni/ theg pa bla na med par ngais pa'i tshig go /de la lha dang nor bdag dri za dang*/ /sogs dang*/ las dang grub pa chung ngu rnams kyis/ tshogs lam gyi yon tan gtso bor bstan par mngon la/ khyad par drod ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi grub sbyor bas/ /'phral du yid ches yang dag 'jug /ces pas bstan/ rtse mo ni/ thams cad kyis ni mi mthong zhing*/ / sogs kyis bstan/ bzod pa ni/ de phyir ye shes 'di gsang zhing*/ /mi gsal yi ge med pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan te/ go rim bzhin nus pa rnyed pa dang*/ ye shes kyi lha 'grub pa dang*/ rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i rnam rtog gsal po 'gags pa rnams so/ /chos mchog ni dus bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ nas sgo dgu las ni byung ba'i rdzas kyi bar la/ mthar thug gi bshad pas/ mthong lam gyi mngon byang dang*/ mthar thug gi mngon byang gnyis ka ston pa'i dang po de'i sbyor bas shugs la bstan no/ /tshe ring brtson 'grus chen po dang*/ /sogs kyis/ gsang spyod kyi phan yon dang*/ lha'i mig dang*/ sogs kyis/ smyon pa'i spyod pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ de yi tshe ni sogs kyis/ kun bzang gi spyod pa'i phan yon bstan/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dpal/ /sogs kyis phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa'i phan yon bstan la/ de ltar rgyun du sogs spyod pa'i dus kyi khyad par ro/ /grub pa kun las 'phrog pa dang nas/ /rol mo las byung mkhyen gyi bar dang*/ rnal 'byor ma kun sbyor ba'i ma/ /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug byed rig pa/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi sgra ji bzhin pa'i bshad pas/ zung 'jug thob pa'i yon tan rnams bstan te/ phan yon gzhan rnams ni/ bskyed rim dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa sogs thams cad kyi phan yon yin no/

/gsum pa 'bras rgyud kyi rnam par bzhag pa ni/ 'bras rgyud dngos/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin la/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang las tshogs ni/ 'bras rgyud dngos ma yin yang*/ de'i phyogs mthun yin pas/ 'dir bshad do/ /de la dngos grub phra mo de dag dang*/ las tshogs rnams ni ngo bo thabs rgyud yin te/ sgrub pa po'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras rgyud dang phyogs mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang nyid 'bad rtsol dang bral/ bde ba'i go 'phang gi gnas thob cing*/ dka' ba med par sems can gyi don 'grub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la dbye na/ 'bras bu chung ngu las tshogs brgyad/ 'bring po thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad/ chen po mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /dang po ni/ rmongs pa dang ni rengs pa dang*/ /gsad dang bskrad pa la sogs dang*/ / dbang dang dgug pa'i las rnams dang*/ /zhes drug dang*/ zhe 'gras pa dang rmugs pa nyid/ /ces pa ste brgyad do/ /go cha drug gi las tshogs rnams kyang dbang dang dgug pa'i las gnyis su phal cher 'dus shing*/ cha shas 'ga' zhig ni gsad par bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mig 'phrul byed ces dang*/ nam mkhar 'gro ba nyid kyang ngo*/ /gzhan gyi grong sogs bya ba dang*/ /mi snang ba dang gang yang rung*/ /zhes dang*/ de bzhin sa 'og 'gro ba'o/ /rig 'dzin 'khor lo bsgyur nyid 'gyur/ /'chi ba med cing rgas pa med/ /rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i rig pa yin/ /'di yis na ba med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rgas pa med pa dang*/ na ba med pa gcig du bsdoms nas/ nad 'joms kyi dngos grub zhes bya ste/ de ltar brgyad do/ /gsum pa ni/ ngo bo sku bzhi dang*/ khyad chos ye shes lnga las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar sku gsum mchog ster ba/ /zhes dang*/ zab mo sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /zhes pas spyir bstan cing*/

sangs rgyas byang chub gnas zhi ba/ /zhes pas chos sku dang*/ de nyid bla na med pa 'grub/ /ces pas ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sogs la mthar thug gi bshad pas longs sku dang*/ gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pas sprul pa'i sku dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ zhes sogs kyis/ dbye gzhi bde chen gyi sku yang bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang byung ye shes lnga ldan 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ sems dang sems med sems rang bzhin/ /sogs kyis bstan zhing 'dir 'phrin las ni lam lnga'i phan yon ston byed thams cad kyis rgyas par bshad par yang 'gyur zhing*/ cho ga'i thabs ni rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa ni/ lha mo yid la 'dod pa rnams ni gsungs pa'o/ /zhes pas kyang bstan/ 'bras bu'i rgyud 'di ni/ phyag 'tshal gyis kyang bstan to/ tshig rkang dang po gsum gyis sku gsum ye shes lnga dang */ lhag mas 'phrin las gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni bshad pa'i sgo de tsam bstan par zad kyi lam spyi dang khyad par gyi mtha' dpyod pa rgyas pa bla ma'i zhal lung thob pas rtogs par bya dgos so/ /da ni de ltar bshad pa de rnams su lung dang rig pas grub pa'i mtha' cung zad brjod par bya ste/ oṃ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par shes pa'i yul yin phyir/ /dngos po thams cad rang bzhin med/ /dngos po yod pa mi srid phyir/ /dngos med ces bya ga la yod/ /tha snyad pa yi tshad ma las/ /snang ba'i dngos po yod min na/ /rtog pas btags pa tsam zhig gi /mi snang dngos med lta ci smos/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba'i/ /gnyis med ye shes rtag tu yod/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /'di ni rtag cing brtan pa yin/ /ye shes kho nas myong ba'i phyir/ /don dam yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /rnam shes bslu bar mi byed pas/ /gsog gsob brdzun pa ma yin no/

/yul dang dus kyis ma bsdus shing*/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i yul min la/ / gnyen pos mi 'dzems nges 'byin min/ /kun rdzob shes pas ma myong zhing*/ / dpyad pa'i yul du ma gyur ba'o/ /de ltar rdzun par 'jog pa yin/ khyad chos brgyad dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'di ni bden pa kho na yin/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma brgyad spangs pas/ /spraus pa med cing mtshan ma med/ /shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs 'di/ /blo 'das brjod bral zhes su brtags/ /rgyu rgyud thabs rgyud 'bras rgyud ces bya ba/ /don dam dbang du gsum po ngo bo gcig /shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs kho na yin/ /kun rdzob kyi ni gsum po tha dad do/ /gzhi yi gshis dang lam gyi chos nyid dang*/ /'bras bu dam pa'i don gyi sangs rgyas gsum/ /chos can dbang gi ming 'dogs tha dad tsam/ /ngo bo gcig cing gnas skabs dbye ba'ang med/ /sna tshogs 'khor ba'i chos kyi rgyu rgyud dang*/ /nyams len byed tshul nyams myong thabs kyi rgyud/ /gsal thob gzhan ngor snang ba'i 'bras rgyud de/ /gsum po 'di dag kun rdzob kho na yin/ /chos nyid gsal dang stong dang bde ba'i phyir/ /lam yang lha sku stong nyid bde ba sgom/ /de ltar bsgoms pas chos nyid de lta bu'i/ /dri ma dag ste mngon gyur 'bras bu yin/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal pos sgyu ma'i rgyal po gzhan/ /'joms pa'i dpe yis yang yang gsungasapa ltar/ /sbyang bya kun rdzob sbyong byed kun rdzob ste/ /'bras bu thob par brtags pa'ang kun rdzob yin/ /rang bzhin rnam dag don dam yin pa'i phyir/ / rnam dag de la rnam par dag pa ru/ /rang ngo shes pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan kyang*/ /don dam kho na yin gyi kun rdzob min/ /rnam par rtog pas btags pa'i lha sku dang*/ /blos byas stong nyid zhu bde'i lhan skyes rnams/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs su brten dgos mod/ /shin tu nye ba'i thabs kyang ma yin no/ /sgyu lus zung 'jug lam gyi lha sku dang*/

/stong nyid dbyings su 'jog pa'i shes pa dang*/ /tshogs drug shes pas gsal bar myong ba yi/ /thig le 'gyur med bde stong lhan skyes rnams/ /gnas lugs rtogs par nye ba'i thabs mchog ste/ / thabs de rnams kyang kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam/ /res 'ga' don dam yin par gsungs srid na'ang*/ /don dam rtogs pa'i thabs la dgongs pa yin/ /dam pa'i don gyi bde gsal stong pa ni/ /rnam shes yul min ye shes kho na'i yul/ / ma bcos lhun grub dngos po'i gnas lugs te/ /rang rig tsam gyi ngo bor rtag tu gnas/ de ltar rgyud kyi spyi'i don blo yul du nges par byas nas/ da ni rgyud kyi tshig gi don bshad pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang dgos pa'i don dang*/ bsdus pa'i don dang*/ tshig gi don gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyud 'di'i tshig gi tshogs ni brjod byed yin la/ rgyud gsum ni brjod bya yin/ de nyid bde blag tu rtogs nas lam la yongs su 'jug cing gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu thob pa ni dgos pa yin la/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa ni dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o/ /brjod bya dang*/ brjod byed dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ nying dgos rnams phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga ma la bltos pa ni 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sgra ji bzhin pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i bsdus don dang*/ mtha' drug la dgongs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i bsdus don no/ /dang po ni bsdus don bzhi bcu zhe gnyis te/ de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gang zhig gis ni sogs shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ chos rnams sogs rgyud gsum gyi rang bzhinadang*/ rnal 'byor ma kun sogs 'bras rgyud rgyas bshad dang*/ yi ge dang ni sogs bskyed rim mdor bstan dang*/ nges pa med cing sogs chags lam gyi che ba dang*/ rtag tu shes rab sogs phra thig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ sems dang sogs ye shes lnga dang*/

ā li sogs kyis gtum mo dang*/ gang gang sogs kyis bsam mi khyab dang*/ dam tshig chen po sogs kyis mchog gi bza' ba dang*/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo rab sbyor sogs kyis mchod pa'i bya ba dang*/ gang gi shes pa'i sogs kyis thig le'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa gnyis ka dang*/ 'dod pa sogs kyis spyod pa phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ bklags pas grub pa sogs kyis rgyud kyi che ba ste le'u dang po don tshan bco lnga'o/ /le'u phyi ma gnyis ni de'i ma tshang ba kha bskong ba ste/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i sogs rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ de la brtul zhugs sogs de'i che ba dang*/ sngags dang sogs rgyud don gyi gtso bo bsdu ba dang*/ de ltar rgyun du sogs/ rnal 'byor goms pa'i dus tshad dang*/ dbang po'i mdog dang sogs go cha drug gi las tshogs dang*/ yi ge drug dang sogs go cha 'god tshul dang*/ mig gnyis sogs bum pa can btsan thabs su dgag pa dang*/ srog dang sogs rtsol bas dgag pa dang*/ 'og min sogs dngos po'i rang bzhin yin yang rtogs dka' ba dang*/ gang phyir sogs rnal 'byor gyi man ngag gis rtogs sla ba dang*/ rnal 'byor sogs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gong bur sogs lus kyi dbus su thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sgo dgu sogs bza' ba'i dam tshig phan yon dang bcas pa'i 'phros te le'u gnyis pa don tshan bcu gsum mo/ /de nas sogs bshad par zhal gyis bzhes te/ dam tshig sogs bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub thabs dang*/ de nas 'dir sogs lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyas bshad dang*/ dang po'i sngags dang sogs bdud rtsi byin gyis rlob nus pa'i tshad dang*/ de ltar rnal 'byor sogs lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i phan yon dang*/ yi ge go bzlog sogs kyis bza' ba'i dam tshig byin gyis rlobs tshul dang*/ rdo rje'i chu dang sogs mchog gi bza' ba brten tshul dang*/ yi ge brgyad kyi sogs bza' ba'i dam tshig brten tshul spyi dang brgyad pa'i tha mar sogs mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang*/

de nas 'dir ni sogs zhu ba glus bskul dang*/ de ltar rtag tu sogs rgyun gyi nyams len spyod par bcas pa'i dus dang*/ rgyan rnams sogs rig ma chas su 'jug tshul phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang po gnyis ni sogs spyod pa'i longs spyod phan yon dang bcas pa ste/ le'u gsum pa la don mtshan bcu gnyis so/ /'dir tshigs bcad du gyur pa ni sogs rgyud kyi don bsdu dang*/ gang gi khyim du sogs ni rgyud 'di'i che ba'i 'phros te/ le'u gsum pa'i 'phros don tshan gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud gsum gtan la phab pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i steng du rgyud tshig rnams 'khrugs sdebs pa nyid yin te gong du bshad zin to/ / gsum pa tshig don la/ bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la mtshan gyi don dang*/ 'gyur gyi phyag gnyis las dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī mahā ma ya tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes pa ste/ de yang*/ shrī ni dpal mahā ni chen po/ ma ya ni sgyu ma'am sgyu 'phrul/ tan+t+ra ni rgyud/ rā dza ni rgyal po/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba ste mtshan thog mar smos pa ni/ lo tsā bas sbyar ba yin kyang rgyud don gyi gtso bo mtshan don la 'du ba yin la/ de nyid kyis na/ dbang po rab kyis mtshan don du go ba zhes bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ste/ des na/ shrī mahā ma ya zhes bya ba la/ ma ni mu dra ste las kyi phyag rgya/ ha ni thabs kyi rtsa kha kha mu kha yi ge ha'i rnam par gnas pa/ ya ni rlung ste de gnyis mnyam par sbyar bas rlung 'gags pa/ ma ni rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba'i thig le/ srog gi a yig ni de rnams la/ rgyas thebs pa'i skye ba med pa/ shrī ni de las byung ba'i dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rnams so/ /'dis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos su bstan pas sngon du bskur rgyu'i bum dbang dang*/

gsang dbang*/ phyis bstan par bya rgyu'i bzhi pa rnams shugs la 'phangs so/ /yang mahā ni yab he ru ka /ma ya ni yum lha mo lnga/ shrī ni thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor ba ste dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor yang bstan la/ yang ma yig gis mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ ya yig gis spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bstan te/ 'khor lo de gnyis kyi lte ba'i rtsa mdud kyang rgya gar gyi yi ge ma ya gnyis kyi rnam par yod pas so/ /ha yig gis snying kha'i hūṃ dang*/ ma ni lte ba'i gtum mo ste/ srog gi a ni a thung yin la/ de yang thig le'i ngo bor gnas pa ni ma nyid kyis mtshon no/ /'bar 'dzag las bde stong gi ye shes skye ba ni shrī ste sngags kyi rnal 'byor bstan no/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob rnam pa sna tshogs pa yin la/ chen po ni don dam stong pa nyid de/ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes ni dpal gyi don no/ /de yang kun rdzob med pa dang*/ don dam yod pa ngo bo gcig pa ni bden gnyis zung 'jug gi don no/ /'dis chos kyi rnal 'byor bstan/ mahā ma ya zhes yi ge bzhis sku bzhi mtshon la/ dpal ni gnyis te/ bdag gi dpal dang*/ gzhanagyi dpal lo/ dang po ni sku bzhi dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid yin la/ phyi ma ni gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'am 'phrin las

so/ /de ni 'bras bu dang sbyar ba yin la/ man ngag gzhan las ni/ sgyu 'phrul kun rdzob chen po don dam sgyu 'phrul lha mo chen po yab/ sgyu 'phrul stong pa/ chen po bde ba/ sgyu 'phrul sku/ chen po ye shes zhes sbyar te gzhi dang bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim dang*/ 'bras bu rnams bstan par bzhed la dpal gyi don ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di nyid lo tsā bas 'gyur gyi tshe bcug pa'am/ rgya dpe la bzhugs pa ltar bsgyur ba'ang srid mod kyi rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bshad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ gzhung dngos so/ /dang po ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ 'di la slob dpon shān+ti pa'i 'grel par bshad pa ni ma mdzad la/ yig mkhan gyis bcug pa yin no zhes gsung bar grags so/ /nag po pa ni/ mahā ma ya'i rgyud dngos kyi tshig ste/ de yang rgyud kyi mdor bstan du bzhed pas/ bshad pa zhib mor mdzad do/ /slob dpon gzhan 'ga' dag gleng gzhir 'dod la/ slob dpon kha cig ni gleng gzhi dang*/ mdor bstan du mi mdzad par tshigs bcad gnyis po 'di ni mchod brjod yin zhing*/ de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs bshad par dam bca'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni rang don du mchod brjod dang*/ bshad par dam bca' byas pa la dgos pa med mod kyi/ rjes 'jug gzhan rnams kyis bstan bcos byed pa'i tshe 'di ltar gyis shig pa'am/ rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po 'grub pa dang*/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i don du/ ston pa nyid kyis gsungs par 'dod de/ 'on kyang 'di ni cung zad mi legs te/ rgyud gzhan gang la'ang de lta bu'i ston tshul med pa dang*/ glegs bam mchog tu dag pa mang po la'ang tshigs bcad 'di gnyis mi bzhugs pa yang yod pa dang*/

shing rta chen po 'ga' zhig gis kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir zhes bla ma rnams gsung pa ltar 'thad do/ /yang bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ jo bo nā ro pa'i gsung gis rgyud tshig dngos ma yin kyang slob dpon ku ku rī pas/ rgyud tshig yi ger bkod pa'i tshe/ gzhung mdzes pa'i phyir thog mar bkod do/ /zhes gsungs so*/ /de la 'di sdom 'byung sogs las 'byung ba'i phyir spyir nas rdo rje'i tshig dngos yin la/ mahā ma ya'i rgyud tshig dngos yin min dpyad pa'i gnas su snang mod kyi/ gleng gzhi dang*/ rgyud kyi mdor bstan ni ma yin te/ tshig don nyid kyis gsal la/ mchod brjod kyang ma yin te/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud gzhan gang la yang yod pa ma yin pas so/ /gang nyan thos kyi sde snod 'ga' zhig la yod pa ni/ dpal gyi mgur nas byung ba ma yin te/ bsdud pa po kho na'i tshig yin la/ bla med kyi rgyud tshig la ni/ gleng gzhi dang*/ mtshams sbyor ba la sogs pa rgyud tshig thams cad kyang ston pa nyid kyi zhal nas gsung pa kho na yin no/ /spros pas chog go /de yang*/ tshigs bcad dang pos 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ tshigs bcad phyi mas zhing gi rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag 'tshal ba bstan no/ /de la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes pa'i dpal ni rang rgyud kyi yon tan dang*/ gzhan don gyi 'phrin las yin la/ de nyid gang la ldan zhing mnga' ba'i dpal sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma ni rdo rje ste rtag brtan g.yung drung gi go 'phang brnyes pa yin la/ mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba ni/ nam mkha'i brdas bstan pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid la/ rig pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba/ shes rab don dam pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ ma zhes mo rtags kyi tshig rnam par brjod pa ste/ de skad du/ rgyud gzhan rnams las kyang ḍeṃ ni nam mkhar 'gro ba ste/ skad kyi dbyings las rnam par brtags/

/nam mkha' kun du spyod grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi zhes pa ni/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad do/ /de rnams kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba ni dpal he ru ka ste/ gang zhig thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa zung du 'jug pa mtshon pa de ni dpal he ru ka dang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku ste/ de'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /ces pas/ sku gsum dang ye shes lnga ngo bo gcig gi bdag nyid do/ /de la spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes chos kyi sku yin la/ de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ de la mnga' ba'i yon tan sa bcu pa nas so so skye bo'i bar gyi gdul bya gzhan snang du sku dang mdzad pa ston par nus pa brtse ba dang nus mthu'i ye shes ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /ye shes de dang rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sku gnyis 'dzom pa'i mthu las sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku snang la/ gzhan rnams la gzo dang skye ba dang*/ mchog gi sprul sku sogs brtan g.yo sna tshogs pa'i snang brnyan 'char ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ sprul pa dngos yin kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ sprul pa'i sku dngos ma yin te/ gdul bya gzhan snang yin pas so/ /'on kyang sku de gnyis kyis bsdus par 'jog ste/ de gnyis kyi mthu las byung ba'i phyir/ mar me'i 'od mar me'i chos su bsdu ba bzhin no/ /gang rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ sprul pa 'byung ba'i gzhi gang yin pa de ni/ de dang de'i sku dngos su rnam par gzhag go /ye shes lnga ni/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gnas pa ni chos dbyings ye shes dang*/

ye shes de nyid kyis chos thams cad gzigs pa ni me long ye shes dang*/ gzigs pa'i chos thams cad mnyam par rtogs pa ni/ mnyam nyid ye shes dang*/ ngo bo stong pa nyid yin kyang kun rdzob mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa mkhyen pa ni sor rtog ye shes dang*/ rgyu 'bras mtha' dag cig car gsal bar rtogs pa'i rgyu las byung ba/ sems can thams cad la mnyam par 'jug pa'i snying rje chen po dmigs pa med pa ni/ sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i phyir/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'phrin las ni/ 'gro ba skyob la zhes pa ste/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa las yongs su skyob pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni/ kun rdzob tu sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ don dam par ye shes de nyid rtogs par byed pa ste/ gang gis rang gi ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin phyir phyag yin/ /zhes so/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes sogs la/ ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas pa yin kyang rnam pa 'gro ba lnga po gang rung gi lus can tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar gyi lam la gnas pa ltar ston pa dang*/ dngos su yang sa bcu gnyis la gnas pa rnams kyang ste/ zhing rnams na yongs su rgyu zhing spyod pa yin la/ ji snyed ces pa mang tshig ste/ zhing skyes dang*/ sngags skyes dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma'i rigs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma grangs med pa rnams so/ /de'i mdzad pa ni/ bdag dang gzhan gyi kun du rtog pa'i 'ching ba gcod par mdzad cing*/ 'phrin las 'jug tshul ni/ 'jig rten rnams gang la gang 'dul gyi bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa thams cad la rab tu 'jug cing zhugs nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la dkri bar mdzad pa la de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas zhes sogs te/ 'di ni rgyud rgyas pa las yongs su byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ sngar rgyas par gsungs zin pa las slar yang bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du de nas zhes tshig gi mtshams sbyar ba'o/

/slob dpon shin+ti pa'i 'grel pa las/ de nas de la zhes pa'i bshad pa mdzad cing*/ nag po pas ni/ de nas des na zhes pa'i tshig la bshad pa mdzad kyang*/ gzhung phal cher na/ de las dang*/ des na zhes pa'i tshig med cing*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyang de'i dbang du byas nas 'chad pas 'dir yang de ltar bya'o/ /slob dpon kha cig ni/ de nas zhes pa'i a tha zhes pa la/ a ni stong pa nyid de e yig gi don yin la/ tha ni dbyibs kyi khyad par gyis waṃ yig mtshon pa yin pas/ tshig 'di gleng gzhir yang 'dod la/ nag po pas ni/ rgyud 'di la gleng gzhi med de/ theg pa mchog gi lugs la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku yang mya ngan las 'da' ba med pas/ bsdud pa po rnams kyi thos pa sgrog pa mi dgos pa mtshon par bshad mod/ rgyud sde 'ga' zhig la gleng gzhi med pa'ang snang la khyad par rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag bcu drug pa gsungs pa'i rjes thogs su/ bar ma chad par rgyud 'di nyid gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud phyi ma rnams ltar gleng gzhi med pa yin no zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung pa ltar legs so rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa la rdo rje ni 'gyur ba med pa spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa ste/ de lta bu'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma rnams te/ de rnams kyi rgyud ces bya ba ni/ brjod bya don gyi dbang ltar byas na de dag gis rtogs par bya ba ye shes kyi yul nyams su myong ba dang*/ yongs su spyad pa'i don yin la/ brjod byed tshig gi dbang ltar na/ de rnams kyis gsungs pa'o/ /de'i khyad par ni/ mchog tu gsang ba ste/ mu stegs dang theg pa 'og ma'i rigs thams cad la gsang ba'am/ mchog ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin la/ de'i spyod yul de kho na nyid ni gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa'i phyir gsang ba'o/

/mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud ces pa ltar na/ rgyud kyi mtshan ston pa yin pas/ gsang ba ni gsang ba yid bde'o zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /gang ltar yang brjod bya don gyi ming brjod byed la btags pa yin pas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di la yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyi mchog tu gsang ba zhes pa'i mtshan gdags su rung ngo*/ /des na de lta bu'i rgyud bshad par bya ste/ zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i bsdus don rnam pa gnyis kyi steng nas bshad kyang rung mod kyi/ blo gros 'phel ba'i phyir bsdus don rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang le'u dang pos gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad le'u phyi ma gnyis kyis ma tshang ba kha bskong ba zhib mor bstan/ don bsdu phan yon dang bcas pas rgyas bshad la nges shes bskyed pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po la lnga ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bus bsdus pa'i shes bya'i gnas tshul rgyas par bshad/ rten gyi gang zag snod rung du sgrub pa'i phyir dbang bskur ba bstan/ blo dman spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir las dang thun mong gi dngos grub bshad/ nyams len lam gyi ngo bo mthar rgyas su rnam par dbye/ de ltar ston pa'i rgyud kyi che ba ched du bya ba'i gdul bya bstan pa dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la/ shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ rgyud gsum gyi rang bzhin rnam par dbye ba'o/ /dang po la/ shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs dang*/ de rtogs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni gang zhig gis ni kun khyab pa/ /zhes pa nas/ sgyu ma'i bdag nyid ces rnams grags/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la don gyi gtso bo sems dngos po'i gnas lugs sbyar ba dang*/ sbas don lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang sbyar ba/ 'phros don 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang sbyar ba ste gsum las/

dang po ni/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes/ gang zhig gis ni dngos po kun la yongs su khyab pa ste/ gang la khyab pa'i dngos po kun de yang ci zhe na/ rgyu dang mi rgyu zhes te/ rgyu ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad dang*/ mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la khyab bo/ /de yang chos nyid kyi tshul gyis mnyam pa nyid du khyab pa yin zhing*/ de nyid don dam pa'i byed pa por bstan pa ni/ tshangs sgo nga*/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ de yang*/ tshangs pa'i sgo nga las ni tshangs pa byung la/ des ni 'jig rten 'di dag sprul shing 'jig par byed do zhes 'jig rten rnams blos rnam par rtog pa de bzhin du/ de dang mthun pa'i tshig gis bstan pa yin zhing*/ 'jig rten na de ltar 'dogs pa yang de kho na nyid kyi phyogs gcig go ba la bsten nas skyes pa'i 'phrul ba ste/ dmus long gis glang po che la reg pa bzhin no/ /des na gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gang las sgrib bral du gyur pa na/ dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams 'byung zhing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa zhes bya la/ de nyid dri ma dang bcas pa las ni dri ma rnams kyi mthus srid pa 'khor ba'i chos thams cad byung zhing*/ lam bsgoms pas de dag dbyings de nyid du nye bar 'gag pa'ang yin no/ /des na dbyings stong pa nyid kyi ngang las 'khor 'das mtha' dag byung zhing*/ byung ba'i dus na'ang stong pa'i bdag nyid du gnas/ ma dag pa'i chos rnams 'gag pa na'ang*/ de'i bdag nyid du 'gag ste/ de la dgongs nas/ bskyed pa dang*/ 'jig pa'am spro ba dang bsdud pa'i byed pa po zhes dbyings de nyid la gsungs pa yin gyi/ byed pa'i skyes bu yod pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar na chos kyi dbyings de nyid ni tshangs pa'i sgo nga zhes rnam par btags pa'i gzhi yin la/ 'bras bu'i dus na lha mo ste rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad bskyed par byed cing*/

tshangs pa'i brdas ni sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de/ de la sogs pa'i sgras mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs bzhi dang*/ des mtshon pa'i lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang spro bar byed pa'i bdag nyid chen po'o/ /gzhan yang tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ gtso bo dang*/ dus la sogs pa byed pa por btags pa thams cad kyang chos dbyings 'di la brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir de rnams kyi bdag nyid chen po'o zhes kyang bshad par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis ni gsang chen 'di/ / zhes pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis ni mngon du gyur zhing rtogs pa'i gsang ba chen po ste gzhan gyis rtogs par dka' ba shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba 'di ni/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya ste/ dper na sgyu 'phrul gyi rig sngags las nam mkha' stong par yang khang bzang la sogs pa sprul par byed/ shing bu dang*/ rde'u las kyang rta dang glang po sprul pa na/ de dag snang ba'i dus nyid na nam mkha' dang shing bu dang rde'u las gzhan pa gang yang yod pa ma yin zhing*/ med kyang rkyen de dag la rten nas de dang der snang ba bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas spros pa dang bral ba rang gi rig pa'i bdag nyid tsam las/ 'khor 'das kun rdzob kyi snang ba ci yang 'char mod kyi/ shar ba'i dus na yang de'i ngo bor med cing*/ rang rig tsam kho na gnas pa yin la/ nam mkha' sogs med na sgyu ma sprul pa mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ sems nyid med na 'khor 'das kyi snang ba mi 'byung bas de dang des sprul zhes brjod kyis/ sprul par bya ba dang*/ sprul pa po yongs su 'brel pa ni med la sgyu ma dang 'dra ba yang dag pa'i sgyu ma yin pa'i phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o/ /de nyid ni bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir dbang phyug chen po zhes bya la/

sgyu 'phrul chen mo de nyid ni lam bsgoms pas 'khor ba'i chos thams cad yongs su zad par byed pa'i phyir/ drag mo chen mo zhes kyang bya'o/ /de ltar yang dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ rang gis 'phrog cing rang gis byed/ /rang nyid rgyal po rang gtso bo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /stong pa nyid las 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ 'byung ba las gyur pa'i dngos po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i tshogs rnams sgyu ma ltar snang ba shar ba'i tshul gyis bskyed par ma zad/ sgyu ma'i snang ba nub pa ltar 'gro 'ong med pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par bsdud par mdzad pa'ang yin la/ dper na chu rlabs thams cad la chus khyab pa bzhin du/ kun rdzob kyang ji ltar snang ba de thams cad ni yod pa ma yin la/ de dag la ji ltar yod pa'i chos nyid thams cad la ni rang gi sems nyid kho na bdag gcig pa'i tshul gyis yongs su khyab po zhes/ don ni chos nyid tha dad med

pa'o/ /de bzhin du rgyu ba bcud dang*/ mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten gsum po 'di kun la shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs sems nyid gang gis byed pa po/ /rgyu'i tshul gyis khyab pa dang*/ ngo bo rang bzhin gcig pa'i tshul gyis kyang khyab ces brjod do/ /de lta bu'i chos nyid de lam bsgom pa'i tshe de nas yang ni ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di thams cad gdod ma nas med pa la med par rtogs pas spang bya spong du med pa'i tshul gyis dbyings der yongs su bsdus nas sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa don dam pa'i 'jig rten gsum po dag pa gnyis ldan gyi tshul gyis slar yang spro bar byed do/ /de'i don ni ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gags nas dag pa'i ye shes spro ba ste/ dag pa de nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs su gdod ma nas yod pa yin kyang dri ma spangs pa'i tshe mngon du gyur pa na slar yang spros pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir yang spro ba'o zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa ste sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di rtogs pa las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'jog pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bskyed byed kyis don dam dbyings shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma 'di ni gong du bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan de rnams kyi phy-ir sgyu ma'i bdag nyid ces rnam par grags pa yin no/ /zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig gis ni sogs la snying khar gnas pa'i bzang po'i thig le gang zhig gis ni dngos po kun la yongs su khyab pa yin te/ phyi rol snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad rang lus kyi rtsa khams kyi mthu las snang ba yin la/ lus mtha' dag ni/ dang por thig le de las skyes shing*/ gnas pa'i tshe yang de nyid kyis dbang bsgyur bar byed la/ 'jig pa'i tshe yang gzhan rnams kyi nus pa de la thim nas 'gag par 'gyur bas/ lus kun la khyab/ sems la rten gyi tshul du yod pas thig le 'gyur ba la sems kyi 'gyur ba 'byung ba'i phyir khyab pa zhes bya/

de phyir 'di la tshangs pa'i sgo nga dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pas bsnyad cing*/ lha mo thams cad ces pa la/ lha mo ni spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi ste/ de'i brdas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung bstan pas bzang po'i thig le las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung bstan pas bzang po'i thig le las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung snying kha'i rtsa 'dab bzhi la 'bab pa rnams bskyed par byed cing*/ des kyang lus kyi 'byung ba bzhi mtha' dag bskyed do/ /tshe dang stobs sogs yongs su 'phel ba'i phyir dbang phyug chen po zhes bya la/ tshe'i nus pa zad pa na thig le 'dir nyid kyi mthus 'chi ba ster ba'i phyir drag mo chen mo/ de'i tshe 'byung ba thim rim gyis yongs su bsdud par yang byed la/ rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum zhes pa la/ rgyu ba ni rlung*/ mi rgyu ba ni sems te/ rlung sems thim pa las/ snang ba dang*/ mched pa dang*/ thob pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'jig rten gsum 'char bar 'gyur la/ de'i mthar 'od gsal du yongs su bsdus nas slar yang bar do skye srid kyis bsdus pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'jig rten gsum spro bar byed do/ /de'i phyir gsang ba rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi ma mo'am bskyed gzh-i snying kha'i thig le 'di ni sgyu ma chen mo'am sgyu ma'i bdag nyid ces bya ste/ 'di las dkar dmar gyi tshogs pa sprul pa dang*/ de dag gi rnam 'gyur las khams sna tshogs pa sprul zhing bsdud par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo dngos ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin la/ de'i longs sku yang snang tshul dang gnas tshul gnyis kar bsdoms pa la byed dgos shing*/ de'i sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni sprul sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku gsum ni shes bya thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du khyab pa dang*/ 'phrin las la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba'i phyir kun la khyab pa dang*/

gzhan snang du sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs pa spro zhing bsdu bar mdzad pa ste/ ye shes kyi lha sgyu 'phrul chen mo gang zhig gis ni rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba kun la khyab pas longs sku zhing dang bcas pa ni tshangs pa'i sgo nga dang mtshungs la/ lha mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spro zhing*/ tshangs pa'i brdas bstan pa he ru ka zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa sprul par mdzad pa 'gro ba rnams la phun sum tshogs pa stsol zhing*/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub khyad par can sbyin par mdzad pa'i phyir dbang phyug chen mo/ nyes pa rnams 'joms shing gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i phyir drag mo chen mo ste/ de ltar mdzad pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'jig rten gsum du bsdu zhing spro bar mdzad la/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir 'byung ba'i khams kyi sprul pa spro zhing bsdu bar yang mdzad do/ /de ltar yang*/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/ nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /ces pa ltar ro/ /de rnams kyi kha sbyor la sogs pa yan lag bdun yang bstan pa'o/ / gsang ba pa sogs la/ de'i phyir gsang ba pa sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis longs sku 'di ni sgyu ma'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum sgrub rigs pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ thang las skyes zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la sgra ji bzhin pa dang man ngag gnyis las sgra ji bzhin pa'i rig pa'i don ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs yongs su rtogs pa'i phan yon te/ yang dag pa'i ye shes 'di ni 'jig rten gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i rig pa ste sngags yin la/ rig pa zhes pa'i skad dod/ bi d+yai zhes mo rtags yod par bshad de/ lha mo'i rig sngags yin pa'i don no/ /don dam pa'i rig sngags 'di ni 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster ba yin la/

sgrub po gang gis gnas lugs 'di rnam par rab tu shes pa tsam gyis sgrub po'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur zhing*/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i chos mtha' dag rig cing shes par byed pa nyid yin no/ /gzhan yang lha'i gtso bo rnams dang*/ nor bdag ste gnod sbyin gyi gtso bo dang*/ dri za mthu bo che rnams dang*/ gter gyi bdag po ma yin pa'i gnod sbyin phal pa rnams dang*/ thag bzang ris la sogs pa lha ma yin dang*/ mi'i 'gro bar bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gang yang rung ba rig sngags kho nas dgos pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ don thams cad sgrub pa la sogs pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ dud 'gro'i 'gro bar gtogs pa gzugs dang longs spyod dang rdzu 'phrul phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen mo ste klu'i rgyal po rnams dang*/ yi dwags kyi 'gro bar gtogs pa srin po dang*/ sha za ste kun tu rgyu ba'i 'dre rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gang ci yang rung ba de thams cad sgrub pa po de la mngag gzhug byed cing 'dod pa thams cad ster ba'i tshul gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes de kho na nyid rtogs na de rnams ma bsgrubs par yang 'grub pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig ce na/ 'byung po phal pa rnams thams cad dang*/ chu srin la sogs pa chu las skyes pa dang*/ stag la sogs pa thang las skyes pa rnams kyang ste/ rus sbal zhabs dang*/ ḍom+bi he ru ka bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la cung zad brtan zhing*/ sngags kyi nus pa grub/ yi dam gyi lha la gnang ba thob na de dag sgrub pa'i tshul yang ston pa yin la/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha dang*/ thig le mchog ma la sogs pa'i lha'i smad 'tshong ma dag ni de bang ru'i shing la gzugs bya/ dzam+bha la la sogs pa'i nor bdag ni gser dang dri za rnams ni tsan dan dang*/ gnod sbyin phal pa ni ras bris dang*/ mi ni spra tshil dang*/

rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang ras bris dang*/ mi'am ci ni rdo leb dang*/ lto 'phye chen po sogs klu ni nā ga ge sar gyi shing dang*/ srin po rnams ni ro sol dang*/ sha za rnams ni shog ga shing dang*/ de dag gi lha mo rnams kyang rgyu de dang mthun te/ gzugs brnyan byas la/ lha de rnams su bskyed cing spyan drangs la dbang bskur te rab gnas bya'o/ /he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor zla gam byas la lha lnga bzhugs su gsol nas mchod gtor sbyin bsreg sogs kyis mnyes par byas te gsol ba gdab bo/ /de'i mdun du so so'i maṇ+ḍal bya ste/ srin po la ni khrag chen po bdud rtsi lngar bcas pas dang*/ sha za rnams la ni chu dang chang dang spos kyi phye mas bya la/ klu rnams la ni/ gla rtsi dang*/ nā gi yongs su spangs pa'i dri bzang po 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i dang*/ gzhan rnams dri bzang ci bde bas maṇ+ḍal byas la der gzugs brnyan bzhag go /mi yi ni ling ga'i tshul gyis gan kyal du 'jog la/ gzhan rnams ni mchod pa'i don du bzhugs su gsol lo/ /lha min la ni gzugs brnyan byed pa med de/ maṇ+ḍal nyid mchod par byed do/ /gnod sbyin rnams la shing 'bras ba dan dang bcas pa dang*/ lha min la chang dang*/ klu la dkar gsum dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la me tog blug pa'i gtor ma dang*/ mi'am ci la ba glang gi sha dang*/ gu gul gyi gdug pa dang bcas pa dang*/ srin po la sha khrag dang*/ sha za la sran chan no/ /nyer spyod lnga ni thams cad pa sbyar bar bya'o/ /sngags rkang pa re re'i hūṃ phaṭa kyi nang du/ de dang de'i ming smos pa'i mthar a gats+tsha lan gnyis sbyar ba ste/ dper na/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha mahā prah+ma ṇa ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni bsnyen pa'o/ /des de dag 'ongs pa mthong na dngos grub kyi don du gtso bo'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ sid+dhi badz+ra su ra ya hūṃ zhes pa ni lha sgrub pa'i dang*/ su ra ya hūṃ gi tshab tu/

a su ra ya a zhes pa lha min dang*/ da na dha oṃ zhes pas nor bdag dang*/ gan+dhar+bha swāhā zhes pa dri za dang*/ yo yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa gnod sbyin dang*/ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi swāhā zhes pa rig 'dzin dang*/ oṃ ma no ha ri swāhā zhes pa mi'am ci mo dang*/ rang ming gis mi'am ci dang*/ phuḥ.ā gats+tsha nā ga phu zhes pa klu chen dang*/ kro ka ri swāhā zhes pa srin po dang*/ mi tsi mi tsi swāhā zhes pa sha za rnams bsgrub par byed pa'i sngags so/ /gal te ma grub na thams cad la/ hūṃ ha na phaṭa ces pas gzir bar bya'o/ /gnas kyi khyad par yang mi'am ci ni ri'i rtse mo dang*/ srin po ni dur khrod dang*/ klu ni chu ngogs dang*/ lhag ma ni ci bder sgrub bo/ /mi rnams mngag gzhug tu sgrub pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad pa'i dbang gi las yin la/ gzhan rnams de dag thams cad nyid bdag gi drung du 'ongs nas/ sgrub pa po bdag gis ci zhig bgyi zhes pa'i bar du bsgrub pa yin la/ de nas yid la 'dod pa'i don smras te mchod pa tsam gyis don 'grub pa yin no/ /'byung po phal gyi sgrub pa ni/ nya sha sha chang la phug shing 'bras sna tshogs pa btab pa'i 'bru chan gyi gtor ma bya la/ sa stegs kyi maṇ+ḍal rgya spos kyis byugs pa dag bya zhing gzugs brnyan mi dgos so/ /dgug pa'i sngags ni/ rang ming la ā kar+ṣaya dza/ zhes btags pa ni bsnyen pa yin zhing*/ 'byung po phal pa rnams la las phra mo byed pa las dngos grub sbyin rgyu med pas dngos grub kyi don du sgrub pa mi dgos la/ gzhan lhag ma snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa'i srog chags rnams dbang du byed pa ni gong du bshad pa'i sgrub pa po dbang du byed pa'i sngags dang dmigs pa kho nas chog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyud gsum gyi rang bzhin rnam par dbye ba ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /zhes pa nas sgyu ma kun gyi rnam par rol/ /zhes pa'i bar te/

de yang rgyu rgyud dang*/ thabs rgyud dang*/ 'bras rgyud bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos rnams thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ye shes te/ de la 'od gsal ba'i don dri mas ma bsgribs pa'i don yang yin mod kyi/ sgrib pa bkag tsam gyi med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid can la ni/ 'od kyi don yang ma tshang la/ gsal ba'i don yang ma tshang ngo*/ /de na spros pa mtha' dag spangs pas khyad par du byas pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir na gsal ba dang don dam pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang bcas pa'i phyir 'ong ste/ 'od gsal gyi skad dod/ pra bha swa ra zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ pra bha ni pra bha wa ste yang dag pa'i dngos po'am/ yang dag par yod pa'i don te/ ye shes kyi snang ngaur don dam pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa'i don te 'ong ngo*/ /swa ra ni dbyings dang srog dang*/ a swa da ra sa de/ ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ snang bas khyab par byas pa rnams la 'jug pas 'dir yang na des mtshon pa'i sgra'am dbyangs dang*/ chos thams cad kyi srog chos nyid kyi tshul du gnas pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ror shar ba dang*/ rang rig rang gsal gyi bdag nyid can rnams te gsal ba'i don no/ /rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de'i khyad par ni glor bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag gis gdod nas dag pa ste/ dri ma de dag gi ngo bor nam yang med pa yin zhing*/ rnyog pa med pa ste de nyid kun rdzob tu dri ma dang bcas pa'i dus na yang dri ma de dag gis de ngan par ma byas pa ste/ de ltar na/ rang nyid dri ma'i ngo bor med cing dri mas ma gos pa yin la/ de'i dri ma yang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs pa kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad do/ /de ltar na gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sems kyi rang bzhin de ni yongs su grub pa dang*/ skye 'gag med pa dang*/ rtag cing brtan pa yin te/ de ltar yang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/

sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la mnyam par gnas pas dur khrod do/ /gdod ma nas grub pa ni rtag tu grub pa ste 'char ba dang nub pa spangs shing*/ nam mkha' ltar yongs su grub pa rtag tu bde ba chen po'i tshul gyis dmigs pas de'i rang bzhin du byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rnyog pa med pa'i don bla ma gong ma rnams dngos po dang*/ dngos med dang btang snyoms kyi rnyog pa med pa zhes gsungs pa yang gtso bo'i don la 'di nyid de/ dngos po yul yul can rnams dang*/ de dag la bltos pa'i dngos med de thams cad kyang 'dus byas so/ /de ltar yang dbu ma las/ dngos po gzhan du gyur ba na/ /dngos med yin zhes skye ngan smra/ /zhes dang*/ dngos dang dngos med 'dus byas yin zhes so/ / btang snyoms ni/ de lta bu'i dngos po dang dngos med ltos grub tu bzhag nas/ gnyis char bkag tsam gyi med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de gsum gyi mtshan nyid 'di la med pa'i phyir ye shes rnyog pa med pa'o/ /ci ste ye shes de nyid yod na mi stong pa yod pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i stong nyid yod na stong pa yod par 'gyur bas/ gal te mi stong cung zad yod/ stong pa cung zad yod par 'gyur/ /mi stong cung zad yod min na/ /stong pa yod par ga la 'gyur/ /zhes dbu mar gsungs pa'-i rigs pas gnod par 'gyur ro/ /snyam na/ bden te 'on kyang 'di ni gnod pa ma yin no/ /'di'i don ni stong pa dang mi stong pa zhes spyi khyab tu sbyor ba ma yin te/ dngos po re re nyid la rnam par bzhag pa yin par snga ma'i tshig gi 'brel las shes pa yin no/ /gal te slob dpon bud+dha pā li ta dang*/ bha bya la sogs pas stong pa dang mi stong pa spyi khyab tu bkral bas so snyam na/

de dag ni gzhung 'di la tshad ma ma yin te/ gal te tshad ma yin na yang rig byed dang*/ dran pa'i gzhung ltar slob dpon de gnyis kyi tshig kyang phan tshun shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir 'gal ba la ma 'khrul pa'i tshad ma yod par 'gyur la/ gzhung gcig nyid la lung tshad ma dang tshad ma ma yin pa'i dbye ba ni mi rung ste/ 'khrul pa mang du smras pa'i rjes su legs par smras pa yang srin bu'i yi ge dang 'dra'o/ /'o na khyod kyi lugs la ci zhig ce na/ gal te bum pa yod par gyur na ni bum pa bkag pa'i stong nyid kyang yod rigs na/ bum pa gdod ma nas med pa'i phyir de bkag tsam gyi stong nyid kyang med de/ bum pa dang bum pa bkag pa'i stong nyid gnyis kar rtog ngo tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don te/ des kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /don dam pa la ni mi mtshungs te/ don dam pa ni mi 'gog cing mi khegs pa'i phyir/ de bkag pa'i stong nyid kyang mi srid la/ don dam pa'i kun rdzob ma yin kyang kun rdzob bkag pa'i stong nyid kyang ma yin te/ don dam pa la kun rdzob kyi dgag sgrub gnyis ka bral ba'i phyir ro/ /dpal gshin rje gshed nag po las kyang*/ chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'di yi ngo bo ni/ /de la gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med/ / skye dang 'gag pa dag ni yod ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad/ /dngos po med ces ma bsgrags pa/ /zhes kyang gsungs te/ bde ba chen po la gzung 'dzin med pa dang*/ dngos po dngos med las grol ba don dam par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ thabs brjod ces pa ste/ thabs ni thabs kyi rgyud smin par byed pa'i dbang dang grol bar byed pa'i lam/ brjod pa ni slob dpon gyis slob ma la bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar bstan pa ltar nyams su blangs pa de yis slob ma sgrub pa po de yi rgyud la ni gong du bshad pa ltar dri ma thams cad spangs pa'i ye shes lnga/

mngon gyur du ldan par 'gyur te/ 'bras dus kyi ye shes de'i khyad par yang dri ma thams cad spangs pa mngon du gyur pa yin mod kyi rang byung zhes smos pas bskyed pa'i rgyu rkyen thams cad spangs shing*/ gdod ma nas lhun gyi grub pa'o/ /gzhan yang thun mong dang 'brel ba'i yon tan gyi khyad par thob pa ni lam gyi dus nyid nas 'byung ste/ sngags skyes la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma kun gyi 'du ba khyad par can thob pa'i sbyor ba dang rnal 'byor gyi ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma thob par 'gyur la/ khams gsum du gtogs pa po'i rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dngos grub dang longs spyod ma lus pa kun ma lus shing lus pa med pa 'grub par 'gyur te/ gang ci yang rung ba 'di mi 'grub ces pa'am 'di mi thob ces pa med pa'o/ /gzhan yang sprul pa sgyu ma lta bu yul dang dus dang rnam pa kun gyi sems can rnams kyi don du sgyu 'phrul rnam par rtse ba la sogs pas rol par yang byed do/ /yang bshad pa'i rnam grangs gzhan ni/ rnal 'byor ma kun gyi 'jig rten pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i ma ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pho nya mo ste/ ma lus 'grub pa ni don dam stong nyid rtogs pa dang*/ sgyu ma sogs kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur mthong ba'i don du'ang bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad ces pa nas/ mig 'phrul byed ces pa'i bar te/ de la don gyi gtso bo sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang*/ rnam grangs sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ste/ de'i dbang bskur ba chu dang cod pan dang rdo rje dang dril bu dang ming gi dbang rnams so/ /slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka la yang dbang gi ngo bo ni lnga las gzhan du med de/ gang slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba logs su byed pa la yang dam tshig gsum sbyin pa sogs sngon 'gro'i cho ga'i khyad par ma gtogs/
